title: Faithfully optimized
description: This is a optimization modpack to optimize gameplay for high end and low end devices, it is recoomended not to remove any of the mods because your fps will drasticly decrease. this was created with every single mod, resource pack, and shader in in this pac
body:
This is my newest optimization modpack; it basically triples your FPS. You will go from around 10 FPS to 100 FPS if you configure all the settings properly. This pack also comes with some community-favorite mods like AppleSkin, Sodium, Iris, Litematica, and shaders that will run smoothly when settings are set to low.

I am making this because not everyone in the world has a laptop or PC strong enough to play Minecraft at a good frame rate. When your FPS is low, your game looks choppy, so this modpack was created with everyone's devices in mind to make your game run better. It was built with every single mod, resource pack, and shader in this pack in mind. This is a custom creation that goes beyond what Sodium Plus does. Credit to them!

Bug report or new feature here: https://forms.gle/UEDKXKWKfryaBHXm8
